Definition: a puff, i.e. wind, angry or vital breath, divine inspiration, intellect. or (concretely) an animal
BiblicalUsage: The breath of life is what God breathes into man's nostrils in the garden, and the same breath is what He takes away in judgment — nothing that breathes is to be left alive in the cities under the ban, and the blast of the breath of His nostrils lays bare the channels of the sea. One breath gives life; the same breath, withdrawn or rebuking, ends it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my life is borrowed breath: the same God who breathed me into being holds every breath I take, and I live only because He keeps giving it. Every breath I take is a gift I did not make, and one day the Giver will ask what I did with it.
